definition: Select a set of neoantigen elements (mutations) within a budget constraint that minimizes the sum of log-probabilities of no immune response across all cells in the tumor population
assumptions: Cell-level response probabilities are computed from upstream prediction tools (pVACtools: cleavage, MHC binding, pMHC stability)
Response probabilities for different vaccine elements are independent per cell
Combined cell response: P(response) = 1 - prod(P(no_response_j)) for selected elements j
Adaptive method: optimize across multiple simulation replicates to find robust composition
invariants: Budget constraint: exactly K elements selected (K=10)
MinSum objective: minimize sum of log(P(no_response)) across all cells
non_negotiable_steps: Simulate cell populations with stochastic peptide presentation
Score each vaccine element per cell using prediction pipeline
Optimize element selection under budget constraint
Evaluate across multiple replicates for robustness
